# Adopted dependency evidence

F1 inventories only exact locked backend and web releases with registry/source/license metadata and actual vulnerability/consistency/smoke reports. Metadata is not legal advice or a blanket license/security certification. Preserve distribution notice files when packaging; inspect unknown/nonstandard/copyleft requirements before reuse. No upstream application code or model weights are copied.

Separate future parser/OCR/scanner, embedding/speech/model, evaluation/FSRS and optional DeepTutor extraction dependencies must pass their own exact closure before installation or use. See development/dependency-scope.json. The quarantined EduStudio pin and unapproved whole LMS runtimes are never dependencies of this baseline.
